items.name: Finsupp.support

items.name: Finsupp.support_zero
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [Zero M] : Finsupp.support 0 = ∅

items.name: Finsupp.ofSupportFinite_support
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [Zero M] {f : α → M} (hf : (Function.support f).Finite) : (Finsupp.ofSupportFinite f hf).support = hf.toFinset

items.name: Finsupp.support_embDomain
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [Zero M] (f : α ↪ β) (v : α →₀ M) : (Finsupp.embDomain f v).support = Finset.map f v.support

items.name: Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [Zero M] {f : α →₀ M} : f.support.Nonempty ↔ f ≠ 0

items.name: Finsupp.fun_support_eq
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [Zero M] (f : α →₀ M) : Function.support ⇑f = ↑f.support

items.name: Finsupp.mem_support_toFun
items.type: {α : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [Zero M] (self : α →₀ M) (a : α) : a ∈ self.support ↔ self.toFun a ≠ 0

items.name: Finsupp.onFinset_support
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [Zero M] (f : α →₀ M) : Finsupp.onFinset f.support ⇑f ⋯ = f
